description: Underground Data and Power Conduit is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. This layer represents underground infrastructure within the City of Moreton Bay (CMB) region, compiled for submission to the Before You Dig Australia (BYDA) platform. Coverage: City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. The portal files it under the publisher City of Moreton Bay's Data Hub. Its tags are assets, byda, underground. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
